justification: Changes the page link and pointer text served for council rules whose words are hidden, on every route that uses quoteColumns. Read path only - no write, no schema change.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a proven rule's page is replaced by a section page, a hidden rule with no section_page gets an anchor, the rule's own located page loses to the section page, or the section_page SQL drops the proven / same chapter / same heading / 12-page window conditions
falsifiable_check.observed_red: First version took min(quote_page) over the section. Live measure: 64 of 314 links landed >10 pages from the rule (Ashfield DS4.1 proven on 12 pages, rule on 199 linked to 17). Window + nearest: 294 linked, 0 with gap >10, median gap 0. Tests pin the window and ORDER BY.

pre_impl.existing_data: 2026-10-28 production read: 684 live actionable rules quote_status='unconfirmed'. 294 get section_page; 66 have no section heading; 324 have no proven rule of the same heading within 12 pages.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Section headings are not unique within a chapter (Ashfield DS numbers, Parramatta 'Controls'), so 'same section' alone does not fix a page.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuses quoteColumns (selected by every serving route) and pageAnchor/pageLabel/unprovenNote; no new route or table. Prior-art: no sibling-page code existed (grep section_page/sibling/#page=).

functions.name: quoteColumns
functions.input: table alias of a regulatory_provisions row
functions.output: quote columns plus section_page: nearest proven sibling quote_page within 12 pages, same council/chapter/heading
functions.if_none: NULL when no heading, no pdf_page, rule proven, or no proven sibling near

functions.name: sectionPage
functions.input: a served rule row with page and quote fields
functions.output: section_page when the rule does not show council words
functions.if_none: returns null, so no section page is used

functions.name: pageAnchor
functions.input: a served rule row with page and quote fields
functions.output: quote page, else own located page, else section page for an unlocated row
functions.if_none: null - plan opens with no page

functions.name: pageLabel
functions.input: a served rule row with page and quote fields
functions.output: 'section near PDF page N' for an unlocated row with a section page
functions.if_none: same labels as before this change

functions.name: unprovenNote
functions.input: a served rule row with page and quote fields
functions.output: 'Wording not shown here — read it in its section, near PDF page N of the council's plan'

queries.purpose: Nearest proven page of the same council, chapter and section heading
queries.where_clause: sib.is_current AND sib.source_council = a.source_council AND sib.source_chapter_key = a.source_chapter_key AND sib.section_header = a.section_header AND sib.quote_status IN ('exact','recovered') AND sib.quote_page > 0 AND council_quote not blank AND abs(sib.quote_page - a.pdf_page) <= 12

break_it.scenario: A repeated heading sends the rule to a far page of another part of the chapter.
break_it.how: Nearest proven page within 12 pages only; measured 0 of 294 links more than 10 pages from the rule.
break_it.repro: SELECT ... quoteColumns('a') ... WHERE is_current AND v2_is_actionable AND quote_status='unconfirmed' -> count abs(pdf_page-section_page)>10

break_it.scenario: The rule was dropped from the new PDF, so a nearby page does not hold it.
break_it.what_happens: Pointer says 'in its section, near PDF page N' - it does not claim the rule is on that page; words stay hidden.
break_it.how: Wording says 'near', and the page is always one whose words were proven in the current PDF.

break_it.what_happens: Property and chapter pages load more slowly.
break_it.how: Evaluated only for unproven rows; uses idx_rp_source_chapter. Explain analyze on a whole chapter: 294 ms.
break_it.repro: EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT quoteColumns('a') FROM regulatory_provisions a WHERE document_id=... AND is_current

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: open a Hornsby or Ashfield property page with a hidden rule and confirm the pointer names a PDF page and the chapter link has #page=.
